plans.idea: Left-aligned editorial column: the headline is set big over two lines and the subheadline sits on the same left edge below it, so the right third stays clear for the decorative circle instead of crowding it.
Banner read: a full-width centered band so the headline fits on one line, which removes the orphaned 'sunset.' the engine leaves, with the tracked subheadline centered underneath as a quiet sign-off.
Poster block: a tall, centered text box lets the headline wrap to two large, balanced lines that fill the canvas height, so the type dominates the frame the way it does in the square original.
